ticks.note: Tick 1 only enters A; all three of its transitions are delayed.

All three transitions are enabled (the third has no trigger). They are tried in the order written (priorities 1, 2, 3) and the first enabled one wins: x = 1, state B. The effects of the other two do not run.
B goes back to A (delayed). A is entered in this tick, so its own delayed transitions are not checked.
Only priorities 2 and 3 are enabled; priority 2 wins: x = 2, state C.
C goes back to A (delayed). A's own transitions wait, since A was entered in this tick.
Neither trigger holds, so the transition without trigger fires: x = 3, state D.
D goes back to A. taken (transition order A1, A2, A3, B, C, D) = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1].
